Differences in Insulin Sensitivity Among Diverse Populations 
Members of US racial/ethnic minority groups have higher rates of insulin resistance than non-Hispanic White 
members of the population. This is most likely attributed to both genetic and lifestyle factors (Caballero, 2018).
